message.reasoning_content: need to identify crimes based on facts: In prison, defendant Wang X took a glass bottle, assaulted police officer Duan XX, causing head scalp laceration. This is assault causing injury. Under Chinese criminal law, "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) applies. Also possibly "聚众斗殴" not, because only one victim. Could be "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public duty) for assaulting police officer. Chinese law: Article 277 of Criminal Law: "以暴力、威胁方法阻碍国家机关工作人员依法执行职务的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金。" That's "妨害公务罪". Also "故意伤害罪" under Article 234: causing injury. The fact: He assaulted police head causing scalp laceration, which is injury. So both crimes may be charged. The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". Both are directly supported. So list "故意伤害罪;妨害公务罪". Use Chinese legal terms. Format: [罪名]故意伤害罪;妨害公务罪<eoa>
